title: Only Training
note: Original anime comedy micro-drama in the format of a short viral fan video: a girl lies to her stern father, a cheerful boy walks into the lie, hook ending. 16:9, one locked snowy street, burned-in captions, a cut every 4-6 seconds. No borrowed characters, names or voices.
logline: A girl swears to her stern father that she was only training, right until the boy she was definitely not meeting waves hello.

voices.Lyra: bright, quick teenage girl with a clear expressive voice, lightly sarcastic, a little squeaky when panicking
voices.Aldric: deep, cold, slow aristocratic man in his fifties, quiet menace, every word measured
voices.Kai: cheerful, warm teenage boy with a slightly breathy easygoing voice, friendly and oblivious
